title: Flight of the Night Butterfly
statementMd:
You need to guide a night butterfly through the darkness. Its starting point is the common center of six radial tracks, numbered clockwise from 00 to 55. Track 00 is the **main track**; the other five are **auxiliary tracks**.

Only certain intervals on the tracks are lit. The main track has one set of lit intervals, while all five auxiliary tracks share another set. All lit intervals are closed, and their endpoints represent distances from the center.

Before each flight, you may choose **a positive real** speed d, which remains fixed throughout the flight. The butterfly starts at the center at time 0. At every positive integer time t, it is on track (tmod6) at a distance t⋅d from the center. Thus, it visits tracks 1,2,3,4,5,0,1,2,… in this order.

You are given q queries, each specifying a target distance T. You want the butterfly to reach the main track at some time k, at a distance T from the center. Thus, k must be a positive multiple of 6, and k⋅d=T. At every integer time 1,2,…,k, the butterfly must be within a lit interval on its current track, or it will fall into darkness and lose its way. There are no restrictions at other times, including time 0.

For each query, find the earliest time k at which the butterfly can safely reach its target, or print `-1` if it cannot. The queries are independent, and you may choose d separately for each query.

## Input

The first line contains two integers n and m (1≤n,m≤50), representing the numbers of lit intervals on the main track and in the set shared by all five auxiliary tracks, respectively.

Each of the next n lines contains two integers l and r (1≤l≤r≤1018), representing a lit interval [l,r] on the main track.

Each of the next m lines contains two integers l and r (1≤l≤r≤1018), representing a lit interval [l,r] shared by all five auxiliary tracks.

Within each set, the intervals are pairwise disjoint and are given in increasing order of their left endpoints. In particular, consecutive intervals satisfy li+1>ri.

The next line contains an integer q (1≤q≤100), representing the number of queries.

Each of the next q lines contains an integer T (1≤T≤1018), representing the target distance of one query.

## Output

For each query, print on a separate line the earliest time k at which the butterfly can safely reach its target, or `-1` if it cannot.

## Note

For T=6, choosing d=1 lets the butterfly reach the target at time k=6. The distances at the first five integer times are 1,2,3,4,5, all in the lit interval [1,5] on the auxiliary tracks. At the sixth integer time, the distance is 6, which is in the lit interval [6,6] on the main track.

For T=12, choosing d=1 lets the butterfly reach the target at time k=12. Its distances while on the auxiliary tracks are all in [1,5]∪[7,11], while its distances on the main track are 6 and 12. To arrive at time k=6, it would need d=2, but then at time 3 it would be at an unsafe position at distance 6 from the center on an auxiliary track.

The diagrams below show the query T=12. The first two use d=1, and the third uses d=2. Gold segments and points are lit intervals. Dark blue dots are labeled with their times, and the red cross marks a position in darkness. The second panel continues from the hollow dot at time 6. Dashed arrows show only the order of integer-time positions, not the actual flight path between them.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c43f23c658b8c505d9c57cfce09608ae98409ed5.png)

For T=18, the target is outside every lit interval on the main track, so it cannot be reached safely.
statementZhMd:
你需要引导一只夜蝶穿过黑暗。它的起点是六条放射状轨道的公共中心，这些轨道按顺时针方向编号为 00 到 55。轨道 00 是**主轨道**，其余五条是**辅助轨道**。

轨道上只有某些区间被照亮。主轨道有一组照明区间，而五条辅助轨道共用另一组照明区间。所有照明区间都是闭区间，其端点表示到中心的距离。

每次飞行前，你可以选择一个**正实数**速度 d，该速度在整个飞行过程中保持不变。夜蝶在时刻 0 从中心出发。在每个正整数时刻 t，它位于编号为 (tmod6) 的轨道上，与中心的距离为 t⋅d。因此，它依次经过轨道 1,2,3,4,5,0,1,2,…。

给定 q 次询问，每次询问指定一个目标距离 T。你希望夜蝶在某个时刻 k 到达主轨道上距离中心为 T 的位置。因此，k 必须是 6 的正整数倍，且 k⋅d=T。在每个整数时刻 1,2,…,k，夜蝶都必须位于当前轨道的某个照明区间内，否则它就会陷入黑暗并迷失方向。其他时刻（包括时刻 0）没有任何限制。

对于每次询问，求夜蝶能够安全到达目标的最早时刻 k；如果无法到达，则输出 `-1`。各次询问相互独立，你可以为每次询问单独选择 d。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m (1≤n,m≤50)，分别表示主轨道上的照明区间数量，以及五条辅助轨道共用的照明区间数量。

接下来 n 行，每行包含两个整数 l 和 r (1≤l≤r≤1018)，表示主轨道上的一个照明区间 [l,r]。

接下来 m 行，每行包含两个整数 l 和 r (1≤l≤r≤1018)，表示五条辅助轨道共用的一个照明区间 [l,r]。

每组中的区间两两不相交，并按左端点递增的顺序给出。具体而言，相邻区间满足 li+1>ri。

下一行包含一个整数 q (1≤q≤100)，表示询问次数。

接下来 q 行，每行包含一个整数 T (1≤T≤1018)，表示一次询问的目标距离。

## 输出格式

对于每次询问，单独输出一行，表示夜蝶能够安全到达目标的最早时刻 k；如果无法到达，则输出 `-1`。

## 说明

对于 T=6，选择 d=1，夜蝶便可在时刻 k=6 到达目标。前五个整数时刻到中心的距离分别为 1,2,3,4,5，均位于辅助轨道的照明区间 [1,5] 内。在第六个整数时刻，距离为 6，位于主轨道的照明区间 [6,6] 内。

对于 T=12，选择 d=1，夜蝶便可在时刻 k=12 到达目标。它位于辅助轨道时到中心的距离均属于 [1,5]∪[7,11]，而位于主轨道时到中心的距离分别为 6 和 12。若要在时刻 k=6 到达目标，就必须选择 d=2，但这样一来，在时刻 3，它就会位于某条辅助轨道上距离中心为 6 的不安全位置。

下图展示了询问 T=12 的情况。前两幅图采用 d=1，第三幅图采用 d=2。金色线段和点表示照明区间。深蓝色点旁标注了对应时刻，红色叉号表示黑暗中的位置。第二幅图从时刻 6 的空心点处接续。虚线箭头仅表示各整数时刻位置的先后顺序，并不表示这些位置之间的实际飞行路径。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c43f23c658b8c505d9c57cfce09608ae98409ed5.png)

对于 T=18，目标不在主轨道的任何照明区间内，因此无法安全到达。
